differs.layout: Two compact cascades mirrored on one ground line, their paid pools meeting in the centre under the stated gap, with a short centred heading instead of a left headline and one big staircase.
differs.data: A comparison: the same 1,000 visitors run two funnels (old onboarding vs guided), instead of one funnel's stage counts.
differs.mechanic: Before riders must jump open gaps between ramps and spill into one lost trough; After ramps carry guard rails and joined chutes, so riders slide through and fewer drop.
differs.moment: The end state: two paid pools side by side at clearly different water levels, a bracket between them and "2.4×" derived from the riders that landed.

blurb: The same riders go down two slides at once; the guided one loses fewer at each lip, so its paid pool fills 2.4 times higher.
